::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 29 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/7
:::

Dear Madam

I wish I could promise a ready admittance to My English Servant into the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), but I am afraid that sending it to me would only involve an almost endless waiting.  Some stories I have had by me for two years, and I think yours deserves a better fate, I wish the [SPCK](organizations/other_40.qmd) would take it, I can’t understand their principles, for I am sure there are two or three stories in their last set of no use to anybody!

yours truly
C M Yonge
